rules.title: Hoboken ban on algorithmic rent coordination
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.key_value: ban on software/algorithms/data-sharing platforms to coordinate rents, lease terms, occupancy
rules.citation: Hoboken City Code ch. 158, Art. II
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.effective_date_note: Law-firm alert says effective July 2025; no day given.
rules.conflict_note: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect.
rules.review_note: Only a secondary source (law-firm alert) available; ordinance text not captured.

parsed.notes: Merged duplicate candidates c92 and c99 (same alert, two mirrors). The documents only support the algorithmic rent-setting ordinance for Hoboken. The link-only Hoboken ecode360 sources (D032-D034) could not be read, so no other categories were added from them.
